name: Default From Query
description: Populates REDCap field default values by executing named SQL queries against the REDCap database. Queries are defined at the system level and referenced in field action tags as @DEFAULT-FROM-QUERY='query_name'.

action-tags.description: Sets a field's default value by executing a named SQL query stored in the module's system settings. The query must be associated with the current project and must return a single value. Usage: @DEFAULT-FROM-QUERY='query_name'
